_about: ALL design values for ColdTrust Twin live here. Change a number here and every screen, test and graph uses the new value.

site.name: Visakhapatnam
site._note: Sea-level pressure used until real weather (PS) is loaded.

chamber._note: U = k / thickness = 0.022 / 0.100 = 0.22 W/m2K. Air films and thermal bridges ignored (see ASSUMPTIONS.md).

door._note: Openings/hour and seconds/opening are design-point guesses. In LIVE mode the door switch gives the real open fraction.

pv._module_note: Array = modules of 225 W (0.87 x 1.30 m, about 20 % efficient) in 2 rows up the slope. 1.8 kWp -> 8 modules (as in the pictures); 2.1 kWp -> 10. Used only to draw the 3D model.

pcm.name: Paraffin (organic)
pcm.latent_range_note: Datasheet range for this paraffin is 190-200 kJ/kg. We use the LOWER value (190) to be safe.
pcm._note: Slab thickness = mass / (density * area) = 115/(800*12) = 12 mm. 'Fully used' = all wax liquid and warmed to the 8 C top of the band.

grid_backup._note: Automatic transfer switch moves the compressor to grid when PCM battery < 15 % and there is no solar power.

physics_check._note: If |measured - predicted| room temperature stays above threshold for longer than persist_minutes, the sensor is flagged.

design_ambient._note: A typical hot, humid Visakhapatnam summer afternoon, used for the design-point report.

door_schedule._note: Average door openings for each clock hour 0-23 (IST). Loading hours 7-10 am and 4-7 pm are busiest, a few in the day, almost none 10 pm-6 am. The simulator draws a random (Poisson) number around this average each hour; each opening lasts a random 8-22 s (mean 15 s). About 54 openings per day in total.

simulation._note: Stock = produce already in the room (3 days x 200 kg) at room temperature; it is thermal mass. A new 200 kg batch arrives at 8 am each day at 25 C and cools toward room air; the 4 h pull-down time is treated as the industry 'seven-eighths cooling time'. After 24 h the batch joins the stock and an equal old batch leaves at room temperature.

controller._note: normal: room held at target on solar; surplus solar freezes the PCM; at night the PCM cools the room; grid (ATS) only when PCM < 15 % and no sun, or the room passes 7.5 C. forecast: uses TOMORROW's real weather from the file as a perfect forecast. If tomorrow is sunny (>= 5 kWh/m2 on the panel) the PCM may be used down to 5 % tonight, because the sun will recharge it. If tomorrow is cloudy/rainy, today's spare solar is used to pre-cool the room and stock to 3 C, to carry extra cold into the dull day.

day_classes._note: Days are classed by plane-of-array (panel) irradiation: sunny >= 5.0, cloudy 2.5-5.0, rainy < 2.5 kWh/m2/day.

design_choice._note: How the parametric study picks ONE design: (1) the room must never leave 2-8 C, (2) grid backup must be at most 100 h/yr (about 2 h a week), (3) of the designs that pass, choose the cheapest. PRICES ARE INDICATIVE GUESSES (encapsulated paraffin PCM, installed PV without battery, DC inverter compressor unit) - replace them with real quotations. The study also reports what happens if the PCM or PV price changes.
